## 2024-07-09 - Fix XSS in LLM diagnostic output
**Vulnerability:** The application was vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) due to unescaped rendering of `qcText`, which contained `qualityChecks` generated by an LLM and parsed/stringified via JSON.
**Learning:** Even though the LLM output might go through `JSON.parse` and `JSON.stringify`, if the initial string contained XSS payloads (e.g., `<script>alert(1)</script>`), `JSON.stringify` does not escape HTML characters by default, leading to XSS when inserted into `innerHTML`.
**Prevention:** Always sanitize dynamic content, including JSON data generated from untrusted sources like LLMs, using `Utils.escapeHtml()` before rendering it into the DOM via `innerHTML` or template strings.
